label: Search Bar
description: A search field that tells you what was typed once the typing stops: textChanged restarts a Timer, the Timer runs the emit, and Enter skips the wait. Query and Changed fire on the debounce, not per keystroke, so you can wire Changed straight at a Query Records without hammering it. The clear button appears only while there is something to clear, and Result Count renders as "1 result" / "1,204 results" beside the field.
